Implement Jira ticket {{JIRA_TICKET}} using automatic sdd. It is not allowed to read or write files out of the current folder. If you need to write, use current tmp subfolder which is in .gitignore file. When you start, if the ticket status is "READY FOR DEVELOP", move the task to the "IN PROGRESS" column; otherwise abort process. You MUST always add the final verdict as comment of the ticket.
